# Back up a video project to a private GitHub repo, no git needed

**A project folder becomes a private GitHub repo with a version per approved step, media in Releases and a byte-exact restore.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_483f2b7df560.webp" alt="A video project kept on GitHub: the repo file list with commits, then the README with prerequisites, quick start commands and the project layout." width="480"></p>

Keep an AI video project, or any agent-built project, in a private GitHub repo, even when the person has never used git. The agent does everything: creates the private repo, keeps keys out, saves a version after every approved step, stores big video and audio outside git so GitHub's 100 MB limit never hits, and restores the whole project byte for byte on a new laptop. Sets up the folder layout for mood boards, script, sound, characters, blockout, shots and the edit as text (HyperFrames, Remotion, ffmpeg), records the prompt, model, seed and cost of every take, and gives an undo for anything. Use for "put this on GitHub", "back up my video project", "don't lose my work", "undo", "go back to the old version", "move to a new computer", "organize my project folder", "file structure for an AI video", "edit video in the terminal", "git for video". Not for one-off clips with no later edits, or for teams already happy with their own git setup.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill video-project-github                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills video-project-github --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Back up my video project in ~/films/ferry to a private GitHub repo; I've never used git"
- "Go back to version 8 of the storyboard, I liked the old one better"
- "Move this project to my new laptop and restore every video file exactly"
